sources.title: OpenVoice: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview OpenVoice is an instant voice cloning model developed by myshell-ai that replicates a speaker's voice from a short audio sample and generates speech in multiple languages. The model excels at accurate tone color cloning while providing granular control over voice styles including emotion, accent, rhythm, pauses, and intonation.
